strange_invitation.title: A Strange Invitation
strange_invitation.description: You woke up at the entrance of an unfamiliar town. Something seems to be waiting in the old mailbox.

flowers_for_someone.title: A Flower for Someone
flowers_for_someone.description: Lily asked you to gather three little flowers blooming around the street: a white one near the entrance, a pink one at the plaza, and a blue one hiding behind the bookstore.

objectives.description: Find the white flower near the entrance
Find the pink flower at the plaza
Find the blue flower behind the bookstore
Bring the flowers back to Lily

missing_pages.title: The Missing Pages
missing_pages.description: Three pages are missing from a mysterious book in Arthur's shop — carried off by the wind, he says. One near his bench, one by the plaza, one behind the café.

objectives.description: Help Arthur put the pages in order

letter_never_sent.title: A Letter Never Sent
letter_never_sent.description: Oliver has carried one letter for years without ever delivering it. The address reads simply: the Little Café.

objectives.description: Deliver the old letter to Emma at the café

forgotten_timeline.title: The Forgotten Timeline
forgotten_timeline.description: Photographs were tucked inside the letter. Emma wants help arranging them in the order they happened.

last_destination.title: The Last Destination
last_destination.description: The Stranger says the keepsakes you gathered belong together. Fill the memory box — and the way to the hill will open.

objectives.description: Place the three keepsakes in the memory box

postcards_from_nowhere.title: Postcards from Nowhere
postcards_from_nowhere.description: Postcards keep slipping out of Oliver's bag. Three are scattered around town: by the entrance, behind the yellow house, and near the hill path.

objectives.description: Find the postcard near the entrance
Find the postcard behind the yellow house
Find the postcard near the hill path
